h1: Suno ARR: $300M and 2 Million Paying Subscribers.
intro: Suno disclosed $300M in annual recurring revenue and 2 million paid subscribers in February 2026, up from a reported ~$200M run rate three months earlier. Every disclosed ARR, valuation and funding number is collected below, each traced back to a public source.

modelParagraphs: Suno is a consumer subscription business. Pricing runs from a free tier with daily credits through Pro at roughly $10/month (or $8 annualized) to Premier at about $30/month, with credit packs for heavier generation. Two million paid subscribers at an average somewhere between those tiers is what produces the $300M annual figure — meaning nearly all revenue comes from individuals, not enterprise licensing.

That consumer concentration is deliberate: Suno's growth loop is viral song creation and sharing, so revenue compounds with social distribution rather than a sales team. The unresolved variable is the record-industry litigation filed in June 2024, which remains the principal risk to a model built on training and generating music at scale.
revenueMix: Pro ~$10/month and Premier ~$30/month tiers carry the bulk of revenue.

faqs.a: Suno's CEO disclosed $300 million in annual recurring revenue and 2 million paid subscribers in February 2026, up from a reported ~$200M run rate in November 2025. That implies roughly $25 million of monthly recurring revenue.

faqs.q: How Fast Did Suno Grow From $200M to $300M ARR?
faqs.a: Three months. The ~$200M run rate was reported in November 2025 and the $300M disclosure came on February 25-26, 2026 — a 50% increase in a single quarter, driven by consumer subscriptions.

Consumer subscriptions. Plans run from a free tier through Pro at roughly $10/month to Premier at about $30/month, plus credit packs. With 2 million paying subscribers, nearly all of the $300M ARR comes from individuals rather than enterprise licensing.

faqs.q: What Is Suno's Valuation and How Much Has It Raised?
faqs.a: A $400 million Series D led by Bond Capital in June 2026 valued Suno at $5.4 billion post-money — more than double its $2.45B valuation from February 2025. The company has raised roughly $650M across rounds.

Yes. The $300M ARR and 2 million paid subscriber figures were disclosed by CEO and co-founder Mikey Shulman in February 2026 and reported by TechCrunch, Billboard and Music Business Worldwide — a 'Disclosed' grade on the Clink ARR Leaderboard.
